summary: the launcher suspends a running stand-in QEMU once, refuses a second suspension, counts the stop it sees, and resumes the stopped QEMU when it cancels the machine, so that QMP's quit ends it

argv: exec ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -O1 -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I tests/host -I tools/etude/include -I tools/etude/posix tests/host/etude_qemu_hosttest.c ${SRC}/tools/etude/posix/qemu.c tools/etude/capture.c tools/etude/history_json.c tools/etude/qemu_profile.c tools/etude/processor.c ${SRC}/tools/etude/posix/exec.c tools/etude/posix/keeper.c tools/etude/posix/process.c -o ${WORK}/etude_qemu_hosttest

faults.name: cancel-left-stopped
faults.summary: a cancellation sends QMP's quit to a stopped QEMU without resuming it

faults.name: suspended-twice
faults.summary: the executor takes a second suspension of a suspended attempt

faults.name: stop-uncounted
faults.summary: the executor does not count a stop it has seen
